opennyai_summary.final__facts:
This petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.405/2018 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 3 & 4 Dowry Prohibition Act PS Sagarpur on the ground that the parties have arrived at a settlement vide settlement dated 5th September, 2022 arrived at with the facilitation of Delhi Counseling Cell, Family Courts, which is on record of this Court.
3. Marriage of petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 has since been dissolved by decree of divorce by mutual consent dated 5th September, 2022 and no child was born out of wedlock.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
In the event the draft is not honoured, she may bring the same to the notice of the petitioner no.1 through the IO, who will replace the same.
In event of any non compliance in this behalf, the respondent no.2 shall be at liberty to approach this Court.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.405/2018 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 3 & 4 Dowry Prohibition Act PS Sagarpur and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
7. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
8. Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
9. Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
10. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: In view of compliance of the settlement terms and since the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
